name: Add a trigger to an automation
description: Place the entry trigger on an automation. The trigger exists but is incomplete (is_complete false) until its own settings are saved, for example the list for added_to_lists. Get valid keys from automations.list_step_types.

multiple_entry.description: Let the same contact enter more than once.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Executed through the UI with request capture. Executed by dragging 'Contact added to list' onto the canvas. The call that saves the trigger's settings (choosing the list) was not captured: no list existed to pick. Adding action and condition steps was not captured.
